item.description:
Release v5.19.2

Changes since v5.19.1

  • fix(agent-loop): preserve image attachments through lifecycle hooks
  • fix(network): expose upstream HTTP error reason
  • fix(network): optimize HTTP exchange log loading
  • fix(plugin-message-list): add missing zh-Hans translation for empty state subtitle
  • refactor(message-renderer): hide tool call controls until hover or popover open
  • refactor(project): colocate Xcode configs with app targets
